subtitle_zh: 继续漫步在百老汇大街，两旁林立着各种特色商店。
subtitle_en: Continuing along Broadway Street, we pass many distinctive local shops.

subtitle_zh: 这家 Klothes Rush 是史凯威最大的旅游纪念品商店之一。
subtitle_en: Klothes Rush is one of Skagway's largest souvenir shops.

subtitle_zh: 从阿拉斯加纪念衫、保暖外套，到各种当地特色礼品，应有尽有。
subtitle_en: From Alaska T-shirts and warm jackets to local gifts, it has almost everything.

subtitle_zh: 几乎每位游客都会进去逛上一圈。
subtitle_en: Almost every visitor seems to stop in and take a look.

subtitle_zh: 这栋蓝色建筑就是著名的 Skagway Trading Company。
subtitle_en: This blue building is the well-known Skagway Trading Company.

subtitle_zh: 这里不仅出售阿拉斯加特色商品，还有许多当地手工艺品和纪念礼物。
subtitle_en: It sells Alaska-themed goods, local crafts, and souvenir gifts.

subtitle_zh: 对于第一次来到史凯威的游客来说，这里是最受欢迎的购物地点之一。
subtitle_en: For first-time visitors, it is one of the most popular shopping stops.

subtitle_zh: 眼前这栋白色建筑，就是史凯威最著名的 Red Onion Saloon。
subtitle_en: This white building is Skagway's famous Red Onion Saloon.

subtitle_zh: 它建于 1898 年淘金热时期，最早是一家合法经营的妓院。
subtitle_en: Built during the 1898 Gold Rush, it first operated as a legal brothel.

subtitle_zh: 如今，它已经成为酒吧和历史博物馆，游客还可以参加著名的 Brothel Tour。
subtitle_en: Today it is a bar and museum, and visitors can join the famous Brothel Tour.

subtitle_zh: 这栋带有圆形塔楼的维多利亚风格建筑，非常具有十九世纪的特色。
subtitle_en: This Victorian building with a round tower has a strong 19th-century character.

subtitle_zh: 这里是 Corrington's Jewelry，经营阿拉斯加玉石、象牙雕刻和各种珠宝首饰。
subtitle_en: This is Corrington's Jewelry, known for jade, ivory carvings, and fine jewelry.

subtitle_zh: 即使不购物，建筑本身也十分值得欣赏。
subtitle_en: Even without shopping, the building itself is worth admiring.

subtitle_zh: 抬头望向山坡，你会发现一座巨大的山体时钟。
subtitle_en: Looking up toward the hillside, you can see a large mountain clock.

subtitle_zh: 这就是著名的 Kirmse's Clock。
subtitle_en: This is the famous Kirmse's Clock.

subtitle_zh: 它已有近百年历史，是史凯威最具代表性的地标之一。
subtitle_en: Nearly a century old, it remains one of Skagway's most iconic landmarks.
